summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on June 5, 2026. Shareholders approved a share capital reorganization, adoption of amended articles, and a share capital reduction reducing par value from $0.0001 to $0.00001 per share, with the resulting credit transferred to a distributable reserve. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation event was disclosed. This is a routine corporate housekeeping filing involving capital structure changes approved at a shareholder meeting.
